newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-TENNIS-Teenager Hrbaty win first set from Sampras.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-TENNIS-Teenager Hrbaty win first set from Sampras.

text.p: Teenaged Slovakian Dominik Hrbaty stormed to a one set lead against world number one Pete Sampras in searing heat in their fourth-round Centre Court match at Melbourne Park on Monday.
Hrbaty clinched the set 7-6 after winning the tie-break 7-4, threatening a repeat of the upsets that have so far robbed the women's singles of their top three seeds.
The 19-year-old, the youngest player in the top 100, has never before played Sampras and is playing in his first grand slam tournment here.

Hrbaty has shot up the ranks over the past year, leaping 287 places in 1996 to end the year at 77. He is now ranked 76 and will continue his rapid rise towards the top if he manages to topple Sampras and win through to the quarter final.
Another day of intense heat has forced tournament organisers to lengthen the breaks at the change of ends and put fans court-side to help players cool off.
